context:
Goal: every step of the work path is held by a mechanism, end to end (your ask, 2026-11-07 19:05 CST).
Problem (rule): nothing stops a merge of a lane tip whose head no reviewer passed. A refusal there changes your earlier pick, so it needs your word.
Based on (measured): #1683 and five hand-written review records show the gap (lane process-held-end-to-end).
Based on (ruling): docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md Q1, pick a: "no refusal now".
Departs from: main, where merge --confirm does not read the review record — merge --confirm refuses a lane tip whose review_state is not `done` for that exact head.
Not blocking: #1711 and #1735 go to runner 8 now; nothing waits on this answer.

options.gain: A merge of an unreviewed head is held.
options.how: merge --confirm reads the review record and refuses a lane tip whose review_state is not done for that exact head.
options.label: Grant the refusal (recommended)
options.lose: One more refusal, and it can fire on a bad record.

options.how: No change to merge --confirm. Ask again once only the merge tool can post a review record.
options.label: Keep "no refusal now" until review-record-provenance lands
options.lose: The gap stays open: an unreviewed head can still merge.

title: Should the merge tool refuse a lane tip whose exact head no reviewer passed?
why: The coordinator recommends a: it closes the one gap in the path that the lane measured, and a bad record is a smaller harm than an unreviewed merge.
